sources.label: chromestatus.com — Web Speech API: On-Device Recognition Quality

inputs.rationale: Properties do not take function inputs.

outputs.rationale: Properties represent simple state values rather than returning a functional output.

errors.rationale: No programmatic error throwing or exception behavior is documented for this property assignment.

context.rationale: Contextual background is provided in the document but lacks a dedicated linkable heading for a fragment.

lifecycle.rationale: This property assignment does not have a distinct programmable lifecycle or explicit teardown phase.

securityPrivacy.rationale: No specific security or privacy considerations are documented for this quality property on the page.

notes: Added canonical ids to headings: syntax, browser-support, and see-also. The SpeechRecognition.available() method and other examples could not be inventoried because they reside under unlinked headings (e.g., 'checking model availability') and we are strictly limited to adding only the three canonical ids.

outOfScope.name: SpeechRecognition()
outOfScope.rationale: The SpeechRecognition constructor is part of the baseline Web Speech API, not the new quality feature.

outOfScope.name: SpeechRecognition.processLocally
outOfScope.rationale: The processLocally property was shipped in Chrome 139 and serves as a prerequisite, rather than being the new feature.
